scope: Language-independent TIS2000 transfer prompt and off-by-default local MCP on 0.2.27-preview.3 for Intel and Apple silicon; exact source and retained build inputs, without private history, captures or diagnostic-card binaries.
reviewed_changes: Recognize the TIS2000 transfer prompt from the session card's own localized message (title, step 1, RS232 step); English wording check retained
Same card-derived check on every processing gate, the live workflow poll and display status; display status never writes
Diagnostic screen.raw keeps original LCD character codes beside the ASCII screen.txt
Local MCP stdio server and native binding, off by default (app menu or --mcp-dir)
Retain preview.3 open access, cancellation, consent and SSA-only import validation
Full version and architecture on installed identity, program, window, installer and manifest
